name: Browser Harness
description: Connects an LLM directly to a real Chrome browser over a single CDP websocket, letting the agent write the helper code and site skills it is missing mid-task.

skills.name: CDP Browser Control
skills.description: Drives the user running Chrome over a raw CDP websocket to open tabs, click by coordinates, type, and read page state.

skills.name: Self-Writing Helpers
skills.description: Writes missing helper functions into agent_helpers.py during execution, so the harness gains new capabilities each run.

skills.name: Domain Skill Capture
skills.description: Files site-specific selectors, flows, and edge cases as reusable domain skills in the agent workspace when enabled.

skills.name: Cloud Browser Sessions
skills.description: Starts isolated Browser Use Cloud browsers with stealth settings, proxies, and captcha solving for parallel or headless runs.

skills.name: Session Recordings
skills.description: Captures local video traces of a browser task between start_recording and stop_recording once recordings are enabled.
